It's a shocking proposal for the son of a simple viscount, until he learns that all their attempts to arrange courtships with higher nobles have already failed, and for one simple reason: the daughter's appearance, which has earned her the epithet of the Goblin Maiden. But Ginorious sees his past self in her, and soon learns that she has a genuinely beautiful soul.

Ginorious resolves to use everything at his disposal, including knowledge from his past life, to make her happy.

Her father is the distinguished prime minister; her elder sister, a prodigious mage destined to become their nation’s next Saint. In comparison, Carolina resigns herself to a quiet existence in their shadows until a sudden and unexpected royal decree alters her destiny, thrusting her into a political marriage with the formidable “Bloodthirsty Prince” of the neighboring Empire of Malcosias. Determined to prove her worth, Carolina takes a bold step into a world fraught with both political and mortal peril. As royal obligations intertwine with hints of true love and the stirrings of her own latent power, Carolina moves ever closer to understanding what it truly means to be exceptional.

At the same time, he felt a sense of alienation, not being able to see it in the same way as others. With mixed feelings, he decides that photography is impossible for him. Ogre Verret, the eldest son of the Verret family, a family renowned for its viciousness, is a reincarnator. He was always getting cheated in his previous life because of his kind nature, and he wants to take this opportunity to enjoy the life of a powerful villain who can do whatever he wants. He is supposed be pushing the limits of tyranny, but...

"Well done! Ogre-sama!"

Even though he is behaving in an "insolent manner,'' for some reason those around him seem to be taking it in stride...⁉ The misunderstood villain's life as a saint begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

173241.description:
Poor Yoru was betrayed by the owner of his circus troupe and sold to a male brothel. Every night, Yoru had entertained all kinds of customers until one day, a human-beast hybrid by the name of Amalan pays to have him for the night. Although Yoru has grown used to the job, he's exposed to a pleasure he never once experienced before.

Yoru's life turns upside-down as Amalan requests for him night after night. With an inconsiderate personality and a tendency to beat to his own drum, Amalan has done more to make Yoru hate him than like him, but only sometimes will Yoru see a softer, kinder side from the half-beast...

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: The Lion Dances With a Loved One
title.native: 獅子の踊り子

173242.description:
In a world where killing and torture is a "job", Sero works part-time for a torture company and enjoys torturing people every day with his senior colleague, Siu. New part-timers Mike and Hugh join them, and their happy torture life continues! This is the serialization of a work that became very popular on social media and the doujinshi version that got sold out instantly! A handsome, slightly dark work comedy that will touch your sexuality!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title.native: 拷問バイトくんの日常

173243.description:
The earl’s daughter Sadie has made quite a name for herself as the villainess of the century during the ten years that her body was hijacked. When she realizes she has gotten back in her original body, Rufus, the commander of the knights, is in the middle of breaking off their betrothal. Even when she tells him the truth that her body has been hijacked, he refuses to believe her. Thus, Sadie begins to look for the culprit as well as the cause of the body-switching. Meanwhile, Rufus cannot hide his confusion over Sadie’s sudden change in personality… The story unfolds as the two slowly get closer to each other, overcoming a slew of misunderstandings along the way.

(Source: K MANGA)

title.english: I Body-Switched With an Evil Hag for 10 Years, and Now My Knight Ex-Fiancé Who Never Wanted To See Me Again Can’t Let Me Go
title.native: 10年間身体を乗っ取られ悪女になっていた私に、二度と顔を見せるなと婚約破棄してきた騎士様が今日も縋ってくる
title.romaji: 10-nenkan Karada wo Nottorare Akujo ni Natteita Watashi ni, Nidoto Kao wo Miseruna to Konyaku Haki shitekita Kishisama ga Kyou mo Sugattekuru

173245.description:
Sadie, a countess, had made a name for herself as the evil woman of the century while her body was taken over for 10 years. She has returned to her former self during her engagement being broken off by Rufus, the Knight Commander. She said she was "taken over", but nobody would believe her... Sadie begins a steady search for the culprit who took her body. Rufus, on the other hand, is perplexed by Sadie's sudden change in personality... A fantasy of two one-sided loves that slowly approach each other.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 10年間身体を乗っ取られ悪女になっていた私に、二度と顔を見せるなと婚約破棄してきた騎士様が今日も縋ってくる

title.native: バレンタインに100万倍返しお願いしたら

173247.description:
Young Claire lives with her mother and her twin sister in a humble country home. Feeling mature for her age, Claire is tired of being different from everyone she's ever met. However, when her father suddenly appears, she realizes that she wasn't the only "strange" one in the family. As she slowly learns about her family's past, she understands more about herself and her destiny.

(Source: Pocket Comics)
synonyms: Mon père demi-dieu tombé du ciel
我的半神爸爸是癡情郎
จู่ๆ วันหนึ่งพ่อก็ปรากฏตัว

title.romaji: Totsuren Arawarata Papa wa Obore Aio Deshita

173248.description:
Akira, a police officer, works hard every day, dreaming of a society where beastmen are not discriminated against. One day, she temporarily shelters a stray dog with sad eyes, only to find a naked boy sleeping next to her the next morning! What's more, the boy seems to know the old Akira...?

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title.native: 弾丸ビースト！

173251.description:
Natsume works every day as a company worker. For Natsume, the go-to place when life gets a bit much in this modern world is the "Sister Cafe". At this cafe, Natsume's top favorite is Mai-nyan. One day, Natsume learns Mai-nyan's secret. A tipsy comedy unfolds, connecting with the top favorite through alcohol.

(Source: Comic Cune, translated)

title.native: 酔いすぎ！まいにゃん

173252.description:
Unstoppable force, meet immovable object.

Suguru Shoji, an editor for a girls' manga publisher, is willing to do whatever it takes to rake in the sales; be it playing nice, wheedling, lying, blackmail...he's done it all. Yoichi Yanase, nicknamed "The Prince," is a bookstore employee famous for his good looks, great taste in comics, and being as stubborn as they come. When work brings the two together, sparks fly, and Suguru finds himself going head to head with Yoichi in a battle of wills. Will he get his way, or will Yoichi prove more resistant to his methods than he expected?

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: Behind the Scenes of Manga Editing and Bookstore Staff

title.english: The Secret Circumstances Of A Manga Editor And A Bookstore Employee
title.native: マンガ編集と書店員さんの裏事情
title.romaji: Manga Henshuu to Shotenin-san no Urajijou

173253.description:
"What would've happened to us, if we hadn't kissed that day?"

Miho, who's never been good at making friends, shows up to an alumni meeting in hopes to see his old former friend, Hiroya, one more time. They fell out of touch due to certain reasons, but Miho's determined to put his fleeting crush past him and rekindle their friendship. But when Hiroya says that was married and got divorced, Miho can't suppress his shock. Taken aback by the fact that there is much of Hiroya he doesn't know, he sneaks out of the rowdy reunion venue only to be chased after by Hiroya...!

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: Kiss Me like You Did that Day
title.native: あの日のキスをもう一度
title.romaji: Ano Hi no Kiss wo Mou Ichido

173256.description:
Yamato is a young man like any other. One day, in front of him a wonderful heroine appear, but what is their gender? Join them on a rollercoaster of romantic comedy as they navigate the ups and downs of their youth.

(Source: Comic Fuz, translated)

title.native: 性別不詳に恋をしました。
title.romaji: Seibetsu Fushou ni Koi wo Shimashita.

173257.description:
Honda has been with the company for four years and is getting used to his job. His weekly pleasure is...meeting Hazuki, a convenience store clerk at his work every Wednesday. Hazuki is a charming man, with a face that changes frequently when he talks, a smile he sometimes shows, and just about everything else about him is adorable. One day, Honda forgets his room key and ends up staying at Hazuki's place. They talked so that they could get to know each other better, but somehow they ended up having sex before Honda could confess his feelings. Afterward, he told Hazuki how much he liked him, but Hazuki thought he was just trying to be considerate after having sex with him...! Will Honda's feelings reach Hazuki...?

This is an irritating, frustrating, and yet very cute innocent love story!

(Source: Kasakura, translated)

title.native: それでも君と恋がしたい！
title.romaji: Soredemo Kimi to Koi ga Shitai!

173258.description:
Pure-hearted sentimental love depicting the complex love triangle of an emotionless handsome half-Japanese boy and a dedicated Kansai dialect-speaking delinquent high school boy. A new story is born.

Miki, a delinquent who enjoys fights and is feared by those around him, ends up becoming a library committee member with Ikkei, who is his complete opposite. While they clash due to their contrasting personalities, Ikkei learns one day that Miki has a crush on his childhood friend and senior, Watarun. Despite the surprise, Ikkei supports Miki without prejudice and somehow becomes cherished.

Initially, Ikkei couldn't stand Miki, but as time goes on, he starts to find him adorable...?

(Source: Tokyomangasha, translated)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.

title.native: さんかくトワイライト

173259.description:
Akane and Rei enjoy their life as a same-sex couple. One day, the idol Akane is attacked by a stalker during a fan event. When Takuto, a chiropractor, steps in to save her from the attacker, the two get into an unusual relationship… And then Rei finds out about it, and she wants in, too…? This is a sexy harem story about a man giving a lesbian couple the "rod" that they've been missing!

(Source: Shonengahosha, translated)

title.native: 百合カップルに割って入ってしまった僕は
title.romaji: Yuri Couple ni Wattehaitteshiatta Boku wa

173260.description:
The missionary Xavier arrived in Japan at a chaotic time in history. He was faced with war, persecution, and endless violence. He is the spearhead who must break through all sorts of cultural barriers, and he has only one thing he can rely on: his well-honed body. Set during the Warring States period, the story follows the two-year journey of Xavier and his interpreter and companion, Anjirou.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 鉄腕ザビエル

173261.description: A manga adaptaption of the famous character Gekko Kamen, written by the original creator Kouhan Kawauchi with art by Monkey Punch published in the magazine Manga Joe in 1976.

title.native: 月光仮面

173262.description:
I thought it’d be an easy win, steamrolling a bunch of helpless newbies. But right out of the gate, I accidentally queued straight into Hell Mode! The game’s so brutally difficult that it’s downright hopeless! Every monster, quest, and rule is designed to send players straight to their graves! And surviving?! Unless you’ve got some serious skills to back it up, don’t even think about making it out of Beginner’s Village!

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: I Became the Game's Biggest Villain
I Was Too Crazy, I Became the Villain of the Entire Server!

title.native: 网游:因为太浪,我成了全服公敌!

173266.description:
Maeve, a little Irish fairy, decides to go to the capital, Dublin, to meet her pen pal Annetta, a human girl. The journey she takes with her reliable childhood friend, Molly, and the shoemaker fairy leprechaun, Dink, is packed with excitement.

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.

title.native: アンネッタの散歩道

173267.description: A romantic comedy set in a boys' dormitory, featuring a pessimistic sheep-like girl and a carefree, wolf-like delinquent boy!

title.native: 男子寮のひつじちゃん

173268.description:
"I've always wanted to have your child", but it turns out...

Hilma has honed her magical powers to become the strongest in the kingdom, in order to marry the prince of her dreams, Yuo. However, it turns out the prince actually has a twin! Now Hilma must serve the twin princes, Arm and Yuo...?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)
synonyms: At the Bidding of Twins The Offered Princess Loved by Two Princes

title.native: 夜伽の双子―贄姫は二人の王子に愛される―
title.romaji: Yotogi no Futago: Niehime wa Futari no Ouji ni Aisareru

173269.description: A girl has conflicting feelings about her friend having a girlfriend.

title.native: むこうのぶどう

美女でナイト！ゴージャス ～美しすぎてごめんあそばせ～

title.native: 美女でナイト!

173271.description:
"Just quit already, you idiot!" "I'm sorry, sir!!"

Today again, producer Hata roars insults at clumsy assistant director Igarashi for making a mistake, his shouts ringing through theTV Station. From the outside they seem like a monster boss and an employee in over his head on the boss' bad side. But Igarashi knows Hata's weakness, and he uses that to flip the script to his advantage once night falls!!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: You're Hot When You're Angry, Too
title.native: 怒った顔もエロいです

173272.description: Yuuki Yogo's debut work as a mangaka, written by Kazumasa Hirai, whom he used to be an assistant for.

title.native: バチガミ

173273.description:
Overtime after overtime, Kanda, a company slave without a decent life, one day comes across a murder scene on his way home. The murderer covered in blood... was his former classmate Lizzie! "It's like a dream," says Lizzie, who's happy to be reunited. Kanda barely remembers him, but since Lizzie doesn't have a place to stay, he can't refuse him and decides to let him stay at his house. What will happen when Kanda’s daily life is gradually invaded by this suddenly appearing killer?

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: OΣG！！！＝オー・マイ・ゴッド＝

173274.description: Note: Originally published in Houbunsha's Manga Time Special.

title.native: ハイテンションプリーズ
事件ですョ! ひかるちゃん

173276.description:
Mizuguchi doesn't like his colleague, Ogata. He is not too bad at his job, but Ogata is the only one who gets praised just because he's good-looking and has a refreshing personality. Ogata's halfhearted attitude toward Mizuguchi also annoys him. However, a problem happened in Ogata's house, and Mizuguchi decided to let Ogata live with him for the time being. Mizuguchi is determined to gain Ogata's favor, but soon after they start living together, he discovers Ogata's big secret.

"If I told you that I like you, would you like me back...?" "What? This guy likes me?"

And thus begins a heart-clenching cohabitation life.

(Source: Shinkousha, translated)

title.native: 明日も一緒に帰ろうよ
title.romaji: Ashita mo Issho ni Kaerou yo

173277.description:
Traveling hungry is such a hassle.
A package tour to China : shopping, gourmet food, travelling for pleasure.

(Source: Google Books, translated)

title.native: たびたびあじあ上海

173278.description:
The second volume in the Michiru Noroi masterpiece collection following Jinzou Ningen no Kai! This volume features eight early works, including four that are collected here for the first time.

(Source: Trash Up Records, translated)

1. Noroi no Great Hunting (呪いのグレートハンティーング)
2. Jigoku no Iro (地獄の色)
3. Kao no Nai Dessin (顔のないデッサン)
4. Yozora ni Kieru (夜空に消える)
5. Kasei Koukou no Yoru (火星高校の夜)
6. Kaidan Chibusa no Enokidake (怪談乳房榎茸)
7. Ankoku Shinkai (暗黒深海)
8. Zig Zag Box (ジグ・ザぐ・ボックス)

title.native: 呪みちる初期傑作選Ⅱ 火星高校の夜
title.romaji: Noroi Michiru Shoki Kessakusen II: Kasei Koukou no Yoru

173279.description:
A cute 4-panel comic about a naughty cat and a cheerful family! The author of Neko ga Suki truly loves cats!

(Source: Booklive, translated)

title.native: てくてくとあるこう

173280.description: Dr. Hani is the director of a dental clinic that looks like it's going to collapse at any moment, despite his good skills. Morisawa, a surly and handsome doctor, is forced onto him by his teacher from university!?

title.native: デンタルダーリン

173281.description:
It's a yuri manga!! It's original!!

A wholesome all-ages manga that definitely won't do anything illegal.

(Source: Pixiv, translated)

Note: Originally self-published on Pixiv, was then licensed by Kadokawa for commercial release.
synonyms: A Manga About a Perfect Class President and a Law-Abiding Gyaru
Kanpeki na Iinchou-chan to Gouhou Gyaru-chan no Manga
完璧な委員長ちゃんと合法ギャルちゃんの漫画
There's No Way I Could Date My Fave!

title.native: 推しとの百合はありえない！
title.romaji: Oshi to no Yuri wa Arienai!

173282.description:
He never could have imagined what the cure-all drug was made of!

Recognized for his hard work, Toya Watari has been promoted to work in the No. 1 Research Lab, where rumor has it that development is underway for a cure-all drug. Toya is nervous and full of anticipation as he goes to his new section, finding a vast underground laboratory led by a young and beautiful director by the name of Saku Kamishiro. A little misunderstanding occurs, and Toya finds himself helping with the extraction of the secret ingredient (?) taken from Saku's body. Through trial and error, they find a way to collect samples efficiently!! It's no different from regular intercourse...!! But, Toya and Saku are perfectly serious.

This is the first installment in a titillating comedy of pure souls!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Director! It's Time To Collect A Sample
title.native: 室長！体液採取のお時間です！
title.romaji: Shitsuchou! Taieki Saishu no Ojikan desu!

173283.description:
"Please let me take responsibility!"

Rui, a pharmacist, is a pleasure-seeker who aggressively pursues sexual conquests. One day, he picks up a drunken virgin boy, Takanashi, from a bar he frequents. They have great physical chemistry together, but as usual, Rui leaves the hotel thinking it will be a one-night stand. However, to his surprise, Takanashi begins to fiercely pursue him, telling him "I think I've fallen in love with you, Rui-san." He joins Rui's workplace as a part-time worker and follows his every move, acting almost like a stalker, which is a little off-putting at first. But Rui's heart is gradually shaken by Takanashi and his earnest attitude...?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)
173283.hashtag: #ホワイトナイトビターポルノ

title.native: ホワイトナイトビターポルノ

173284.description:
In the land where Michel lives alone after losing his parents to illness, it starts raining Saturday night. On Sunday morning, the rain turns into fallen angels. Michel finds an egg where fallen angel corpses lay scattered, and Bubu was born. This is a story of love and bonding between a boy with a deep emotional wound and an innocent fallen angel.

(Source: Two Virgins, translated)
synonyms: Bubu and Michelle ~Angel After the Rain~

title.native: ブブとミシェル～雨上がりの天使～
title.romaji: Bubu to Michel: Ameagari no Tenshi

173285.description:
Rem, an occult-loving virgin boy, finds himself attracted to his friendly classmate, the gal Himawari. However, Rem discovers that Himawari is caught in an "astral projection" and can't return to her body. To make her soul return from the astral projection back into her physical body, it seems Rem must make her "climax"...!?

(Source: Yanmaga, translated)

title.native: 夢うつつの花の園
title.romaji: Yume Utsutsu no Hana no Sono

173286.description:
"I'll make you a fine mistress.”

Takuro, an ex-delinquent adult goods manufacturer employee, goes to the home of a customer who has unreasonably complained that his aphrodisiac doesn't work and demands to come and apologize. However, he finds himself in a yakuza office! Takuro gets panicked, but he is greeted by a beautiful and sexy man named Kurumi. Takuro is fed up with Kurumi's arrogant attitude, but then the effects of the aphrodisiac kick in with time lag..!

(Source: Tokyomangasha, translated)

title.native: ラブドラッグ・アフターサービス

173288.description:
In a web of secrets and danger, Eugene, a young woman posing as Derick's male secretary, hides from a tragic and dangerous past. But when a lethal assassin targets Eugene, and other sketchy figures target Derick for his riches, their world crumbles. Bound by a secret, passionate love and a shared history, their fight for survival intensifies as peril looms ever closer. Unfortunately, Derick's ability to guard Eugene continues to slip. Soon, they will have to confront an agonizing question... What does it mean to truly protect the one you love most?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.native: 독점쾌락

173289.description:
Rui had everything...happy family, beautiful fiancee, position as a gourmet writer. But he lost them all. Now he must take his revenge on Zihao.

Shanghai, 1999. A city on the edge. People feared to be called losers. There was a criminal syndicate called Heiban based in Shanghai that controls all of China. Their scale and connections were unbelievable.

As a son of small restaurant owner, Rui, worked as a gourmet writer and loved his job. His fiancee, Honghua was a beautiful colledge student. Rui enjoyed his life, and was confident that his happy life will continue. But he was too naive. Rui knew his childhood friend, Zihao, became a member of Heiban, but he believed they were still friends.

One day Rui helped some children living on the street, and that small good act lead him to tragedy. It was Zihao who destroyed everything he had...Rui decides to do the same thing back.

(Source: KADOKAWA Global)

title.native: 上海ルーザー

173290.description:
Kurae, a first-year art student, is uncomfortable eating in public. He falls in love with his classmate, Arichi, but he cannot bring himself to invite her to dinner. He still tries to get close to her, but she has a secret, too?

(Source: Coamix, translated)

title.native: 青と恋のアトリビュート

173291.description:
Qiguan Xiaojian, the hero who saved the world, is reborn a thousand years later. He wants to live a peaceful life drinking cola, eating fried chicken, and playing video games, while letting his descendants do the work! Will his wish come true?

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Strongest Player Returns After a Thousand Years
I Lie Flat, My Descendants Are All Super Ruthless Characters

title.native: 躺平的我，子孙们都是SSS级
title.romaji: Tang Ping De Wo, Zi Sun Men Dou Shi SSS Ji

173292.description:
The Kingdom of Lienrhein welcomes a person with memories of another world as a saint and queen.
According to this rule, Elys, who has the memory of a "rekijo" (a girl who likes history), becomes the queen, but she is married for political reasons and is forced to live a life where she does not feel the love of King Leenhardt.
When Haruna, who has been teleported from another world, appears, Leenhardt's feelings for Haruna begin to grow.
One day, when she finds out that the king has spent the night with Haruna, Elys finally makes up her mind, "I'm leaving this place!"

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.english: Her Majesty Wants a Divorce: Now that a Saint has Come from Another World, I Suppose I'm No Longer Needed, Right?
title.native: 王妃様は離婚したい～異世界から聖女様が来たので、もうお役御免ですわね?～
title.romaji: Ouhi-sama wa Rikon Shitai: Isekai kara Seijo-sama ga Kita no de, Mou Oyakugomen desu wa ne?

173293.description:
The Kingdom of Lienrhein welcomes a person with memories of another world as a saint and queen.
According to this rule, Elys, who has the memory of a "rekijo" (a girl who likes history), becomes the queen, but she is married for political reasons and is forced to live a life where she does not feel the love of King Leenhardt.
When Haruna, who has been teleported from another world, appears, Leenhardt's feelings for Haruna begin to grow.
One day, when she finds out that the king has spent the night with Haruna, Elys finally makes up her mind, "I'm leaving this place!"

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 王妃様は離婚したい～異世界から聖女様が来たので、もうお役御免ですわね?～
title.romaji: Ouhi-sama wa Rikon Shitai: Isekai kara Seijo-sama ga Kita no de, Mou Oyakugomen desu wa ne?

173294.description:
Every time going back from school, Yotsuba use her usual route. So far there have been no problems and have not found anything strange.

But one day, when a classmate pointed out that there was a mysterious mansion surrounded by roses on the street there, Yotsuba wondered. She came across a handsome fortune teller named Kouya.

According to Kouya's divination, of the five billion people, Yotsuba is a magician. Woah! Why and how do student likes Yotsuba become witches?

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

title.native: TOKYO★魔女ハウス

173296.description:
“I would like you to become my lover.” Daughter of a viscount, Freya Villiers was being pressured into taking back her ex-fiance, Nathan, after their engagement was broken off due to him cheating on Freya with her sister. In order to flee her parents, who are all for her reconciliation with Nathan, she visits Count Bloodbury, feared by the nobles as a “vampire.” With nothing to lose, she asks him to pretend to be her lover and…?!

(Source: K MANGA)

title.english: I Fell into a Situationship with the Vampire Count?!
title.native: 元婚約者から逃げるため吸血伯爵に恋人のフリをお願いしたら、なぜか溺愛モードになりました
title.romaji: Moto Konyakusha kara Nigeru Tame Kyuuketsu Hakushaku ni Koibito no Furi wo Onegai Shitara, Nazeka Dekiai Mode ni Narimashita

173297.description:
Souhei Asakura is a detective whose job is to get rid of the "pests" in society that harm others. However, his catch phrase is "Ah, I want to die"...and he's a downer, loves to eat eggs, plus he uses a rope to snare these "pests" - literally! With unconventional methods and a rope to tie up the bad guys, Asakura teams up with a young police man named Keiichi Tsuji under the orders of his somewhat sadistic boss Miyuki Kanou.

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.native: トクボウ朝倉草平

173298.description:
Eiji Saito, a young boy who strongly admires his older brother Kiichi Saito, who was the legendary head of the biker gang Nakano Bosou Atobu, immediately shows his brightness and leadership when he enters Junior High. Accompanied by his classmates, he refined himself every day with the goal of becoming the fastest and strongest leader. At that time, Sakamoto, who became his friend, gets into trouble with a third year student and is abducted by a new biker gang called Skeleton, based in Ikebukuro.

Requested to come to Ikebukuro alone, Eiji puts on his brother's special uniform, drives his beloved KH400, and rushes to the scene. He ends up competing against the leader, Tamura, on his bike.

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.
synonyms: The Spirit of Tokyo Speed Angels

title.native: マッハヘッド

173299.description: After a year since the epic battle that saved the magical realm. Mash and friends, now a grade higher, are surprised by a visit from elementary school student⁉️
synonyms: マッシュル-MASHLE-  番外編

title.native: マッシュル-MASHLE- 特別読切

173300.description:
Asahi Onozuka, whose father is a doctor who is a human rights advocate for the omega, a rarity in the alpha community, grew up in an ordinary household, Although he is an alpha, when he looks at his life from an objective point of view, it has turned out to be somewhat disappointing. However, by chance, he meets the daughter of a powerful alpha family conglomerate, the Amamiya clan, and unexpectedly marries into her family. He and his wife are on good terms, and he thought he would live an uneventful life.... But then he encounters Totoki, a strange omega who turns out to be his "fated mate." Will their encounter upset the gears of destiny, or will it get him back on track?

(Source: Fig, translated)

title.native: イノセント ベル
忘れられなくしてあげるから

173302.description:
An adaptation of Ling Hua's novel. This is the story of the blossoming youth of two teenage singers, linking the past to the future. They grow up to become the people they want to be and sing their favorite songs. Both travel through time and space to meet and become the stars that guide them to each other.

(Source: Creative-comic, translated)
synonyms: The Time Traveller from Showa Era

title.native: 1934穿越的星與夢

173303.description:
One day, Liu Coixia, a workaholic loner, is diagnosed with acute leukemia. Her life takes a dramatic turn.

She has always lived independently, but faced with chemotherapy in a life-and-death struggle, she has to rely on her family for help.
Will she be able to accept the love and care of those closest to her?
Can she finally reconcile her complicated feelings for her little sister Yidong?
Will she find salvation from an anonymous marrow donor, or must she face more suffering?

If I can find that one person out of 100,000.
Can I finally reconcile my lonely life?

In Taiwan, leukemia patients have only a 1 in 100,000 chance to find a matching marrow donor. The registry is far too small to help all those in need. To encourage understanding of the issue, a well-known author and an award-winning mangaka have been commissioned to produce this manhua with the themes of loneliness and family, to educate readers on the importance of joining the marrow registry.

Sponsored by the Rotary Club of Northwest Kaohsiung, chapter 3510.

(Source: Books.com.tw, translated)
synonyms: Have I Found You? By your blood

title.native: Have I Found You? 與你的血緣
title.romaji: Have I Found You? Yu Ni De Xie Yuan

173304.description:
In 1970s Hong Kong, a mischievous and clever cat-masked boy ventures into the lawless Kowloon Walled City to retrieve his lost report card before his mom finds out.

Tiger is a seven year old boy, growing up in 1970’s Hong Kong. He prefers being clever to working hard, gets terrible grades in school, and dreams of being a superhero. One day, his world is turned upside down when his report card somehow ends up in one of the most dangerous areas of Hong Kong: Kowloon City! Armed only with his homemade cat mask and determination in his heart, Tiger must dive into the twisting chaos and shadowy streetcorners of the Walled City to recover the document.

Can Tiger and his streetwise new friend Dragon find his report card before his mom calls him home for dinner? Or will he be lost in the dangerous maze of Kowloon forever?

Cat Mask Boy is a kinetic journey into another time, full of cultural flavor, warm-hearted humor, and nostalgic urban realism. This thrilling coming-of-age graphic novel explores themes of friendship, self-discovery, and growing up with a touch of retro whimsy.

(Source: Nakama Press)
synonyms: 貓面具少年 CAT MASK BOY

title.native: 貓面具少年

173305.description:
By chance, Haruka Yahata, an office lady, comes to know about the secret of her coworker. Haruka secretly has feelings for him, and instead of keeping it a secret, she presses him to have a sex friend relationship...!?

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

title.native: 毎週金曜、縛られに来て

173306.description:
One day, deliveryman Sakunosuke Oda finds a boy at his doorstep on the brink of death. His name is Osamu Dazai, and he is a member of the Port Mafia—the very embodiment of darkness and violence. Thus begins a peculiar living arrangement: Oda, who cares for the boy, and Dazai, who longs to die. But what will become of their newfound connection when a gang of former police officers known as the 48 attack them in search of a certain painting...?!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: Bungou Stray Dogs: The Day I Picked Up Dazai

title.native: 文豪ストレイドッグス 太宰を拾った日
title.romaji: Bungo Stray Dogs: Dazai wo Hirotta Hi

173307.description:
After an incident, 17-year-old Ochika closed her heart to others. She lives with her uncle and his wife in Edo and spends her days working in silence at their bag shop, Mishimaya. One day, her uncle suddenly puts her in charge of handling customers...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 三島屋変調百物語

title.native: 大いなる逃亡

173309.description: I wish I could just disappear from this world. Saburo, while devastated in a meadow filled with scented thistles, saw a world that was unfamiliar to him. Saburo, who has lost his memory, appears in front of the lively Satoko... A collection of mystery romances that transcend time and touch your heart!

title.native: あざみ野逢歌

173310.description:

173312.description: March 3, 1860, outside Sakuradamon, Edo... 17 Mito Roshi, including retainers of the Satsuma clan, assassinated Dairo Ii Naosuke. No one would have thought that this assassination would later become the beginning of a tragedy for the Aizu clan... - Inoue Okazumi (age 60), a samurai of the Aizu domain with 700 koku of land. Although he was unemployed, he taught his children the Analects of Confucius and the history of Aizu, and his personality was admired by everyone from executives to farmers. Among them were the boys of the Byakkotai 2nd division who would later meet a gruesome end on Mt. Iimori. A work depicting the fierce life of the Byakkotai!

173316.description: Three youkai or supernatural creatures, Bem, Bera and Bero, who arrive at a large coastal city and come across an evil atmosphere, which was brought about by immoral behavior by humans and mischief caused by monsters and yōkai. They therefore decide to stay in the city, fighting against other monsters and yōkai which attack humans, making a few friends along the way. Even though the three yōkai are often abused and discriminated against by other human beings due to their appearance, they still strive in protecting the human populace of the city from other monsters, one day hoping to become human beings in return for their good actions.

title.native: 妖怪人間ベム

173317.description:
A mysterious town, Ginshichou, where ghosts, monsters, yokai, legends, gods, aliens, and concepts all have a form. A gag comedy that depicts the activities and daily life of human and non-human things that work for the police in such a chaotic place!

(Source: Pixiv Comic, translated)

title.native: 捜査班動く！

173318.description: In a street lined with Chinese restaurants, there is a particularly special one among them named Panda-tei. It's run by the genius chef, Momo, who is said to solve any problem in an instant.

title.native: まんぷく！熊猫亭

173319.description: Shirotae will return. With that belief, Shouko does her best to understand the young man's multiple personality disorder. What are Shirotae's origins? How come his entire family are magic users? And how does one go to this alternate dimension, the Lake Nation?

title.native: 変幻退魔夜行　カルラ舞う！〜湖国幻影城〜
title.romaji: Hengen Taima Yakou Karura Mau! Kokoku Geneijou

173320.description: Asato, a high school student with a strong sense of justice, is investigating small pranks that frequently occur at school and comes across the newly appointed school nurse, Egou Nemu. Nemu is admired at school because of her beauty, but she has a curt attitude towards everyone. However, when Asato learns Nemu's secret, he is invited to her home. Asato is at the mercy of Nemu, who has a sweet attitude that she doesn't show during the day, but there is an even more important secret in that room.

title.native: ディディアディクション♡♡♡

173321.description:
Eight years after entering a political marriage, the youngest princess Adel returns to her native country. What awaited her was a marriage proposal from her first love, her attending knight Lewis. She is surprised to find that the once young boy with a cute face has grown into a handsome and dignified young man. Adel can hardly accept the reality of her unexpected partner. The royal romantic comedy of an eccentric, slightly delusional former princess and a straight-laced knight who complicates her love life!

(Source: FK Comics, translated)

title.native: 出戻り（元）王女と一途な騎士
title.romaji: Demodori (Moto) Oujo to Ichizu na Kishi

173322.description:
Hirokuni and Kai are still living together now that they're dating. However, they end up spending their first New Year’s Eve apart. Hirokuni notices something off about Kai, who has been visiting his former boss' family. It seems like he's expected to take over the restaurant...?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Note: A special one shot released in GUSH's Februrary 2024 issue to commemorate the work's live-action TV drama.

173324.description:
His boyfriend cheated on him five times and he was fired from his job at a toxic company. Keiichiro's bad luck has reached its peak, and he has become desperate. There, he meets Kray, a beautiful tan-skinned man who looks at him with a passionate gaze as if he were his lover, and he is swept away into his dreamy arms. The next morning, Keiichiro comes to his senses and realizes that there is no way he could have been so lucky, and flees back to Japan, leaving Kray behind. However, Kray followed Keiichiro to Japan and suddenly proposed to him, saying, "I have missed you so much, my love!" Turns out, he is the fifth prince of the venerable Rasheed Kingdom. He immediately refuses his proposal, saying that he is no match for him, but Kray devotes himself to Keiichiro in an unfamiliar country, saying that he will give his love to him even if it takes his whole life...?

(Source: Honbunsha, translated)

title.native: 王子様の伴侶は憂鬱なハニー
title.romaji: Ouji-sama no Hanryo wa Yuuutsu na Honey

173325.description:
A slow burn BL between a #1 host with a dark side and a tsundere boy with a big difference between his appearance and personality!

Hina is a host, but he gets rash when he touches a woman. He meets a mysterious girl who is the only one who doesn't make him get rash when he touches her. But it turns out that she is a boy named Gonbei! Despite his appearance, Gonbei is rather masculine, and he dreams of becoming a shoujo manga artist. To draw manga and train himself to "flutter," Gonbei makes a special request to Hina.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Please Start Over From The Plot

title.native: プロットからやり直せ

173326.description:
"If I'm going to fall in love, I definitely want it to be with a guy who's as dazzling and charming as a prince!" With that ideal in mind, Risa meets Hino, a classmate who's on the school baseball team, and she sees a surprising side of him. Ever since then, Hino has made her heart race, despite him having zero romantic inclinations, being single-mindedly focused on baseball, the total opposite of a charming prince...?! This is a story of an unexpected case of puppy love over a guy who otherwise really irritates her!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: Yakyuu-bu no Hino ni Koi wo Shita.

title.native: 野球部の樋野に恋をした。
title.romaji: Yakyuubu no Hino ni Koi wo Shita.

173327.description:
Chiaki is good-looking, academically excellent, athletic, and born into a rich family with a super beautiful little sister. He leads a smooth sailing life but still has a problem. He's not popular with girls, and has never once been in love! He vowed to make a fresh start in high school and spend his days being pampered by girls. The morning after making this vow, Chiaki wakes up to find that he himself has turned into a girl.

He is shocked to find that he has lost the appearance that he was so proud of, but when he looks at himself in the mirror, he sees a very cute girl in the reflection. He immediately goes to show it off to his twin sister Kaede, who happens to be very popular with the girls, but there is also something very strange happening to her… This is the story of Chiaki, the second daughter of Saitama Prefecture's three beautiful sisters ―― a dignified first love story that is not embarrassing at all.

(Source: Dengenki Bunko, translated)

title.native: 私の初恋は恥ずかしすぎて誰にも言えない
title.romaji: Watashi no Hatsukoi wa Hazukashisugite Dare ni mo Ienai

173328.description:
'Who says the dead don't tell?'
It was the Japanese colonial era, and the black tiger lost the human couple who took him in and raised him without knowing why. A suspicious woman appeared at that time, Cho-hee. She dissects the body to determine the cause of death and the culprit...
The black tiger joins hands with Cho-hee, who does not know whose side she is on, to seek revenge.

(Source: Naver; translated)

title.native: 범상찮은 밤

173329.description:
Despite the war raging between the North and South, Margaret is a northerner who holds an unwavering love for her southern lover, Squall... until he cruelly betrays her and pushes her off a seaside cliff. Just when she's about to drown, the voice of a mysterious witch offers her a second chance at life. However, this chance only comes to her seven years later, when she rises from the ocean in a new body without a voice. Although Margaret receives help from a local apothecary named Jack, the other southern villagers aren't as eager to let an outsider into their fold...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: The chapter count includes 2 epilogue chapters.

title.native: 파도의 포말
어떤소란

173331.description:
Hinata likes her senior from Theater Club senior. She was quite happy to just see the senior from afar. One day, Hinata went to school library and was suddenly pulled into a book. She has to be a heroine and complete the love story of the mysterious book.

Note: Includes three extra chapters.
synonyms: 目覚めればプリンセス ～恋の魔法にかけられて～

title.native: 目覚めればプリンセス

173332.description:
I got a boyfriend and wore cute clothes. But, why am I so heartbroken?
Eat what you like.
I, "Yajimari", grew up with a strong appetite without worrying about my body shape.
Triggered by a date appointment with someone she cares about, she successfully loses 40 kilograms, starting with her first diet in his life.
Now I can be happy too!
What awaited me was not the "happiness" I had envisioned...
A shocking true story depicting life-size emotions!

A Story About Losing 40kg and Not Being Happy.

173336.description:
Umitarou had no interest in the family business until a single word from his admired girl changes everything, and he decides to become a sushi chef. He promptly consults with his father, the owner, but the condition to inherit the shop is to quit being a yankee. Wanting both his fists and the sushi rice, Umitarou gives a shocking answer...!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 築地最強寿司伝説　仁義理の海太郎
title.romaji: Tsukiji Saikyou Sushi Densetsu: Nigiri no Umitarou

173337.description: A violent gang of bosozoku will find themselves transported to the Sengoku era where a new battle awaits them... Alongside the legendary Oda Nobunaga!

title.native: 戦国アナーキー

173338.description:
Can humans and youkai live together peacefully? Himemiya-san, a high school girl, feels a little awkward among humans because of her half-monster nature.

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

title.native: 君となら裸足。

173339.description:
Tina, an adventurer, is gravely wounded while dungeon diving, and who should come across her but Garon—not just a monster, but the Beast King himself. In exchange for saving her life, Garon demands that Tina help him treat wounded monsters. It’s the beginning of a fantasy story of humans, monsters, and medicine!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

173340.description:
Satsuki is a clumsy boy who can't seem to do anything right. There are days when he hates his life, and the only time he feels happy is when he can be himself singing and dancing in private. One day the popular idol Minami happens to see Satsuki dancing and approaches him. The gorgeous Minami tells Satsuki, "You should become an idol!"

It's a story of idol x friendship x life reversal!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes an additional one shot Glukan (グルカン)

title.native: 花時をかける

173341.description:
Li Ran traversed to another world and became the scion of a demonic sect. When his system awakened, the first mission it gave him is to romance a girl? Li Ran was going to seduce the cute and gullible junior girl, but he ended up sending his love letter to the Master of the sect instead! That woman is a ruthless, cold-blooded, killer! As Li Ran was considering what he's going to do in his next life, he finds out that the master is actually… "very nice!"

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

173342.description:
An up-and-coming newcomer, Mikitoamon, makes her first book appearance!! The most delicate and sensitive parts of the hearts and bodies of all kinds of beautiful girls, including cousins, college girls, runaway girls, president's daughters, and beautiful store clerks. It draws freshly. Please enjoy the world of new sensational lyrical Eros!!

With a passion for richly textured Japanese rock, first-year high school student Chihiro Hatono steps into the world of the light music club, new guitar in tow. But what awaits her behind those doors...? A drama of unfiltered youth and musical ambition takes the stage!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

The protagonist has a crush on his classmate Minase. One day, he is bewildered when he suddenly receives a video of himself naked. Minase enjoys his shocked reaction and escalates the situation. Until finally, his virginity is...

(Source: DLSite, translated)

173345.description:
Jean Erhardt debuted in Joachim Empire as a successful capitalist infamous for buying his noble title. Despite his seemingly innocent intentions, Jean yearned to spark a revolution from within high society. But first, he must gain a powerful friend. A chance encounter with Maximilian, the hedonistic Crown Prince of Joachim, presented Jean with one such auspicious ally. This proved tricky as Maximilian knew of Jean’s past as an escort and the prince hungered for Jean’s return to decadence…

(Source: Tapas)

173349.description: Machiko's job involves disguising herself as various characters, enticing targets, and resolving the client's troubles. The first target is a married man who frequently cheats and excels in erasing evidence. In an effort to help the wife who wants to part ways with him, Machiko seduces the man and strives to create photographic evidence of his infidelity.

title.native: わたしを好きになって

173350.description:
Arata returns to her family home to take over the piano tuning business. There she meets Kyoko, a woman who lives her life as if she refuses to mingle with others. Kyoko was the daughter of an international pianist. The two inexperienced musicians gradually deepen their bond through their love for piano. Moving closer and further apart, they live their lives, reveling in the momentary understanding and closeness.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: Includes the one-shot "Asa ga Kuru (あさがくる)"

title.native: 夏・ユートピアノ

173351.description: A young woman visits a seaside town. Even though it's her first time there, everything seems strangely nostalgic. Somehow she ends up working at an empty little shop serving the local customers. But what will she discover in this strange town that carries the scent of the sea ?

"Gah! Zombies! Run!" They're dead. Hated by humans. They live quietly on the outskirts of town. His dream is to make friends with humans! One day, he has to look after a human girl, but she's afraid of him. ......!</br>
</br>
(Source: cmoa, translated)

title.native: ゾンビがしたいっ！

173353.description:
Udai Daikoku, a hot springs enthusiast, admires an anonymous hot springs reviewer referred to as "Iyashinbou" and uses his reviews as a guide to visit obscure hot springs in mountain villages. Udai has dreamed of bumping into him at a hot spring someday, and that day has finally come. This is the story of the mysterious master and disciple's journey to visit hidden hot springs.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

173558.description:
“F [I Am John Cantlie] imagines Fukushima as a kind of Syria in the fallout of the 3.11 disaster, and follows a British journalist’s infiltration of the region while brutal foreign forces strike into the heart of the remnants of northern Japan.”

The tsunami and nuclear meltdowns of 2011 seem like yesterday. Wreckage still litters Japan’s coastline. Fukushima’s fields are piled high with contaminated soil. Tohoku, northern Japan, furious about how they have been treated by Tokyo, has seceded from the union. The rebels, known as the Nihonmatsu Front, are battling the more heavily armed Japanese government along the southern border of Fukushima. Meanwhile, they are being overwhelmed internally by a faction who call themselves the State of F. Composed of radicalized Tohoku natives and foreign guerrillas, the black-clad F knows only absolute obedience and cutthroat terror.

Though virtually unknown in its home country, Imai Arata’s F is the edgiest work of manga made in the wake of the 2011 disasters. Crossing splintery drawings of the devastations wrought by the tsunami and meltdowns with images sourced from Islamic State propaganda from the Middle East, F trespasses upon many taboos regarding political expression and etiquette in Japan. Originally self-published and sold at avant-garde art exhibitions, Imai’s F is truly underground. It deserves to become a classic.

(Source: Glacier Bay Books)

Note: This was originally published as a doujin work but was licensed and sold digitally in 2024.

The main character, Kwak Chung, who was an orphan from birth and was born in Chengdu, suffered from polio as a child and was disabled in one leg. He sold rice cakes to merchants returning from the West for a living while being ignored by all kinds of uncomfortable bodies, and one day on his way home, he accidentally picked up a lamp. He rubbed it a few times because he thought it would make money if he sold it.

"I will grant you three wishes, my lord." A wish-fulfilling Genie appeared.

"Are you sure you'll grant all your wishes?"

Kwak Chung's first wish is money, not just money, but also enormous wealth such as silver, gold, silk, and jewelry. His second wish is to change into a tall, strong built, handsome and strong man. And the third wish is...

"Let me go back to before I met you."

That's how Kwak Chung's infinite return journey begins!

Gokudou is now a relic, left behind by the times, and the Yamada-gumi, to which Taiga belonged, has been dissolved and reborn as a respectable company. The assassin has become a janitor. His workplace has gone from the underworld to a school. Now, fighting and violence are forbidden for a reputable employee, let alone murder. However, what awaits Taiga is a high school full of delinquents and filled with rampant bullying, violence, smoking, drinking, and all sorts of bad behavior. A situation that even the teachers and other adults can’t handle. “I’ve come to clean up this filthy school.” Making full use of the skills he mastered to survive in the underworld, the former yakuza’s “filth” clean-up job is about to begin!

Aiko, a cocky gal with a sassy tone, got into an argument with Yaeko and her sisters on the street. She is 20 years old and in debt for 2-million yen, stuck with a no-good boyfriend who doesn't work and only getting them into more debt. Aiko sets her eyes on Professor Shinonoi, another resident at the Cattleya Garden, and tries to seduce him for his fortune. The lecherous professor falls right into Aiko's trap...! Twenty-two-year-old screenwriter Shinosuke Kaneyashiki has admired him since he was a child, and he's always had a crush and an extraordinary inferiority complex toward him.
